source: V64 recent exact active-map, observations and lagged spec-proxy declarations; hashes/schema/date preflight before numeric values

signal.mechanism: leverage-constrained demand can overprice high-beta exposure; buy low beta and sell high beta with matched estimated factor risk
signal.return: adjacent complete calendar closes of the exact contract selected before each session; positive prices and volumes at both endpoints
signal.factor: equal-weight arithmetic mean of all4 exact-contract quote returns each day; any missing makes factor missing
signal.beta: trailing252 complete calendar rows: sample covariance(asset,factor)/sample variance(factor); variance greater than1e-24; no shrinkage or full-history fit
signal.selection: first completed trading day each calendar month; all4 finite beta estimates required; unique minimum and maximum among strictly positive betas, at least2 eligible
signal.primary: long low beta with gross*high_beta/(low_beta+high_beta), short high beta with gross*low_beta/(low_beta+high_beta); stable ratio implementation
signal.control: same selected assets and masks, equal-notional +gross/2 and -gross/2; no beta scaling; not a post-outcome replacement candidate
signal.between_selections: hold asset directions and weights; causal active-contract rolls and daily integer resizing in existing portfolio ledger
signal.warmup: 2018-2020 for trailing estimates and preceding monthly state only; start portfolio from fresh cash in2021
signal.model_fit: rolling causal covariance only; no trained predictor or supervised labels

limitations: A new funding-constraint hypothesis on old development prices, not independent data or a literal replication of Frazzini/Pedersen. A mixed four-future equal-weight factor is not an external market portfolio; self-inclusion and shared equity exposure can distort beta.

Prior quote-return beta neutrality is algebraic only. It does not guarantee realized cash beta neutrality, synchronized fills, stable correlations, currency neutrality or crisis protection. Negative-beta instruments are not ranked for BAB legs, but remain in the fixed factor and completeness gate.

Daily candle/spec/fee/margin research proxies, integer quantities, no interest on collateral, no broker/live/demo orders. Order-time gross limits do not guarantee a continuous post-gap gross cap; retain all halts/cancellations/unresolved risks.
One fixed252-session monthly rule, controls and masks sealed before outcomes. No post-result sign/asset/period/window/size/factor/shrinkage/missingness retuning, no promotion of the control.
Only a Stage2 candidate if every declared gate passes at both costs;5percent is a component screen, not a redefinition of the20-50percent annual goal. Goal_verified remains false.
No V94 skewness computation, target reproduction or old economic rerun. Only its map validation helper is reused; no new AlgoPack numeric values or HTTP.
